plants.name: Chrysanthemum × morifolium
plants.description: Dense, layered pompon and spider-like blooms crowd garden borders and temple grounds in rich autumn shades. They keep flowering after many other plants have faded and often last through the first light frosts.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late summer to late autumn (September to November) in the Northern Hemisphere
plants.location: Japan, where autumn chrysanthemum festivals and displays peak in November, and temperate gardens across East Asia, Europe and North America
plants.funFact: Chrysanthemums have been cultivated in China for more than 2,000 years. The flower is the emblem of the Japanese Imperial family, and the Chrysanthemum Throne is named after it.

plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: Whole streets turn hazy purple when this tree flowers. Trumpet-shaped blossoms open before most of the fern-like leaves appear, and they carpet the pavement beneath the branches.
plants.bloomingSeason: Spring to early summer in the Southern Hemisphere (October to November, sometimes into December)
plants.location: Pretoria and Johannesburg in South Africa, and Sydney and Brisbane in Australia
plants.funFact: The jacaranda comes from South America but now lines streets on several continents. Pretoria is nicknamed the Jacaranda City because it has so many of the trees.

plants.name: Camellia sasanqua
plants.description: This graceful evergreen shrub opens delicate, lightly fragrant blossoms with golden stamens in the cool days of autumn. It flowers well before the larger spring camellias and brightens gardens and hedgerows when little else is in bloom.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid-autumn to early winter (October to December) in the Northern Hemisphere
plants.location: Southern Japan, its native range, and the southeastern United States, where it is a popular garden shrub
plants.funFact: Sasanqua camellias belong to the same genus as the tea plant, Camellia sinensis. Oil pressed from sasanqua seeds is used in cooking and cosmetics in parts of East Asia.
